**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The audit rule is satisfied because no audit right in this Agreement binds us. All audit/inspection/verification provisions run against MSL and in IBM's favour:

- **§ 7.0 Audit** — IBM may perform process audits at MSL's Work Centers, with advance notice of scope and method.
- **§ 13.1** — IBM may audit and inspect consigned Products.
- **§ 21.3 / § 21.2** — IBM may inspect tooling.
- **§ 24.1** — "IBM retains the right to audit."
- **Attachment 6 § 4.0 and Appendix A § 4** — IBM/MS audits of MSL's books, records and facilities on 45 days' notice, during business hours, at IBM's cost unless material discrepancies are disclosed.
- **§ 16.14** — mutual record-retention only; grants no audit right.

Targeted searches for a reciprocal MSL right to audit, inspect or verify IBM's records, usage or systems returned nothing, so there is no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure on our side to constrain. Flagging the IBM-side audit rights would strip out protections that benefit us, so no edit is warranted.
